store.description: A selling location or distribution warehouse.

columns.name: timezone
columns.desc: IANA timezone (informational; all stored timestamps are UTC).

columns.name: category
columns.allowed: GROCERY, BEVERAGE, SPIRITS, HEALTH_BEAUTY, COSMETICS, ELECTRONICS, ACCESSORIES, HOME, TOYS, APPAREL, FRESH, HARDWARE

columns.name: uom
columns.desc: Unit of measure; all quantities are counted in this unit.

columns.name: shrink_risk
columns.desc: Merchandising risk class used for count targeting.

columns.name: introduced_on
columns.desc: Date the SKU entered the catalogue.

store_sku.description: Bridge Store N:M SKU (assortment) with effective dates and opening balance.
checks: active_to IS NULL OR active_to > active_from

columns.name: opening_as_of
columns.desc: Timestamp of the opening balance; movements before it are rejected.

employee.description: Actors who post movements, count, approve or investigate.

columns.name: display_name
columns.desc: Synthetic display name (no real personal data).

columns.name: password_hash
columns.desc: PBKDF2 hash; only set for demo log-ins. Never exported.

employee_role.description: Role catalogue. Permissions via RolePermission; people via RoleAssignment.

columns.name: role_code
columns.allowed: CASHIER, STOCK_CLERK, STORE_MANAGER, LOSS_PREVENTION, OPS_MANAGER, ANALYST, SERVICE_FEED, SYSTEM, ADMIN

columns.name: action
columns.allowed: VIEW_STORE, VIEW_ALL_STORES, POST_SALE, POST_RETURN, POST_RECEIPT, POST_TRANSFER, POST_ADJUSTMENT, POST_REVERSAL, APPROVE_ADJUSTMENT, SUBMIT_COUNT, IMPORT_BATCH, RUN_DETECTION, ASSIGN_CASE, INVESTIGATE, RESOLVE_CASE, EXPORT_DATA

role_assignment.description: Effective-dated grant of a role to an employee for a store (or all stores).
checks: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from

shift.description: A staffed time window at a store; every posting is tied to one.

promotion.description: Explains sales uplift; never posts stock itself.

source_document.description: Order/POS references that movements must match.

columns.name: doc_type
columns.desc: Purchase order (receipts) or POS day batch (sales/returns).

columns.name: store_id
columns.desc: Store the document belongs to — the authority for wrong-store checks.

transfer.description: Inter-location transfer order; links dispatch and receipt legs. Status is derived from legs.

import_batch.description: One uploaded file. Immutable; processing state lives in import_batch_status.

columns.name: header_csv
columns.desc: Header line of the CSV (raw rows are stored without it).

import_batch_status.description: Mutable progress projection of a batch (1:1).

columns.name: posted_count
columns.desc: Rows posted to the ledger / counts.

columns.name: quarantined_count
columns.desc: Rows rejected with an error code.

import_raw_row.description: Untrusted input as received (append-only). Never read by stock calculations.

columns.name: row_number
columns.desc: 1-based data row number in the file.

columns.name: raw_line
columns.desc: Row exactly as received (CSV line or JSON).

import_row_result.description: Validation outcome per raw row (append-only, 1:1 with ImportRawRow).

columns.name: source_event_id
columns.desc: Upstream event / count ID (idempotency key with source_system).

columns.name: payload_sha256
columns.desc: SHA-256 of the canonical business payload (excludes received_at).

columns.name: errors_json
columns.desc: All errors found, JSON list of {code, field, message}.

columns.name: authoritative_store_id
columns.desc: Store from the authoritative reference when it could be resolved.

columns.name: explain_qty
columns.desc: Units this row would have removed from stock had it posted (quarantined rows explain count shortages).

columns.name: corrects_row_id
columns.desc: Earlier quarantined row this submission corrects.

columns.name: latest_row_id
columns.desc: Row that currently defines this key's outcome.

inventory_movement.description: The trusted, append-only inventory ledger. Corrections are linked REVERSAL + replacement entries.
checks: movement_type <> 'ADJUSTMENT' OR (reason_code IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL)
movement_type <> 'REVERSAL' OR reverses_movement_id IS NOT NULL
movement_type NOT IN ('TRANSFER_IN','TRANSFER_OUT') OR transfer_id IS NOT NULL

columns.name: ledger_seq
columns.desc: Monotonic posting sequence; used as the ledger watermark.

columns.name: source_event_id
columns.desc: Upstream event ID; unique with source_system (idempotency).

columns.name: movement_type
columns.allowed: RECEIPT, SALE, TRANSFER_OUT, TRANSFER_IN, RETURN, ADJUSTMENT, REVERSAL

columns.name: quantity
columns.desc: Units in the event. Positive, except ADJUSTMENT which is signed.

columns.name: stock_qty
columns.desc: Signed effect on store on-hand (derived from type/disposition/reason).

columns.name: received_at
columns.desc: When the upstream system emitted it / we received it.

columns.name: posted_at
columns.desc: When StashTrace posted it to the ledger.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.desc: Who performed it (service identity for feeds).

columns.name: actor_role_code
columns.desc: Role that authorised the actor at occurred_at.

columns.name: shift_id
columns.desc: Shift covering occurred_at at this store.

columns.name: transfer_id
columns.desc: Transfer for TRANSFER_* legs and transit write-offs.

columns.name: count_ref
columns.desc: Count that a COUNT_CORRECTION adjustment follows.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.allowed: DAMAGE, EXPIRED, SAMPLING, OTHER, THEFT_CONFIRMED, INVESTIGATION_WRITE_OFF, TRANSFER_SHORTAGE, VENDOR_CREDIT, FOUND, COUNT_CORRECTION

columns.name: approved_by
columns.desc: Approver for adjustments (must differ from actor).

columns.name: reverses_movement_id
columns.desc: Original entry a REVERSAL negates (at most one reversal each).

columns.name: batch_id
columns.desc: Import batch (API postings use a one-row batch).

columns.name: import_row_id
columns.desc: Raw row that produced the posting.

customer_return.description: Customer return; posted with a RETURN movement whose stock effect depends on disposition.

columns.name: disposition
columns.desc: What happened to the goods. Only RESTOCK adds sellable stock.

columns.name: original_sale_movement_id
columns.desc: Optional link to the original SALE (receipted return).

stock_balance.description: Cached on-hand per StoreSKU, updated in the same transaction as each posting.

columns.name: on_hand
columns.desc: opening_qty + SUM(stock_qty) over the ledger. Cached; rebuildable.

cycle_count.description: Physical count snapshot. Never posts stock.

columns.name: counted_at
columns.desc: When the physical count was performed.

columns.name: count_cutoff_at
columns.desc: Ledger cutoff the count represents (movements with occurred_at <= cutoff are included).

count_reconciliation.description: Versioned expected-vs-counted calculation for a count (CycleCount 1:N).
checks: expected_qty = opening_qty + receipts_qty + transfer_in_qty + restocked_returns_qty - sales_qty - transfer_out_qty + adjustments_qty

columns.name: basis_status
columns.desc: Whether the count basis is reliable.

columns.name: basis_notes
columns.desc: JSON details for TIMING_REVIEW (violations, movements between).

columns.name: rule_version
columns.desc: Version; params never change within a version.

columns.name: as_of
columns.desc: Evaluation horizon (default: latest occurred_at in ledger).

detection_run_status.description: Mutable progress projection of a run (1:1).

shrinkage_alert.description: Explainable finding. Immutable; its open/closed state follows its investigation.

columns.name: case_key
columns.desc: Stable discrepancy key; reruns never duplicate it.

columns.name: sku_id
columns.desc: SKU when the alert is SKU-level.

columns.name: observed_value
columns.desc: Observed value compared to the threshold.

columns.name: evidence_role
columns.desc: How it supports the alert (CONTRIBUTING, EXPLANATION, DISPATCH, RECEIPT, WRITE_OFF, ...).

detection_run_alert.description: Bridge DetectionRun N:M ShrinkageAlert (history of re-detections).

investigation.description: Case header (immutable). Current state is projected from investigation_event.

columns.name: case_key
columns.desc: Same stable key as the originating alert.

checks: event_type <> 'RESOLVED' OR (resolution_code IS NOT NULL AND length(note) >= 10)

columns.name: event_type
columns.allowed: OPENED, ASSIGNED, REVIEW_STARTED, FINDING_ADDED, RESOLVED, REDETECTED

columns.name: resolution_code
columns.allowed: CONFIRMED_THEFT, COUNT_ERROR, DATA_CORRECTION, TIMING_CORRECTED, TRANSFER_RECONCILED, BENIGN_EXPLAINED, NO_ACTION

columns.name: write_off_movement_id
columns.desc: Separate ledger write-off approved with the resolution.

investigation_state.description: Mutable projection of the event log (rebuildable).

columns.name: last_seq
columns.desc: seq of the last applied event (optimistic concurrency).

job.description: Background work queue polled by the worker.

columns.name: name
columns.allowed: movement, recon, alert, investigation, batch, run, count, return

columns.name: token_sha256
columns.desc: SHA-256 of the bearer token (token itself is never stored).
